_comment: Routing table: OPTIONAL. You don't need to fill this in. It is only a fallback: a model, effort
or stance you name yourself ('implement using <model-id> <effort> <chillin|vibin|supersoldiers>',
or a plan's Orchestration roster) always wins. When neither you nor this table names a tier, the
agent simply asks you. Stance is not in this table: unnamed means Vibin. Auditors are always
named or confirmed by you; the review row is only the suggested default.
install.sh copies this file to routing.json (your copy, untracked). Fill a row only when you want
that choice made for you: tier/escalation/fallback = {"model": "<id from the headless catalogs>",

mechanical.desc: copy, config, renames, formatting, small obvious edits

standard.desc: file-scoped feature work with clear acceptance

hard.desc: cross-file changes, debugging, unclear root cause

review.desc: read-only review or audit (lane A); any family

network.desc: fetch live URLs, web research; needs a smoke test and a fallback
